title: Mixed Duo #18
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Iranian, in her early 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of platinum earrings. Painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye, a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide white bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing with both arms raised overhead, elbows bent, torso fully visible, extreme white extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her early 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, 100 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with pearls in copper-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of gold earrings. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer, deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold-leaf bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, extreme gold-leaf extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
